correctness.rationale: For each connected four-vertex labelled graph F, mandatory-edge one-coordinate integral J(F) is a rational sum over 24 strict coordinate orders with gap simplex volumes 1/6,1/3,1/2,1. Anchor translation invariance and coordinate factorization give J(F)^D. Inclusion–exclusion over all missing edges and orbit factor 24/|Aut(H)| yield all six all-D formulas for claw, path, paw, cycle, diamond, clique. Independently reconstructed all graph types and exact integrals for D=1,2,3,4,7,10, with 36 rational assertions. One-dimensional interval graph prohibits claw and chordless C4; strict planar witnesses prove positive measure for D>=2. Published Haber–Mirabi–Shelah joint Poisson theorem, explicitly treated as premise, converts these volumes to mean a*gamma/24 under n^4 r_n^(3D)->a and fixed D. Dominant 8^D terms yield 3/4 path and 1/4 claw sequential intensity shares, no D(n) claim.
